Fixed the compilation failure caused by the `com.artipie:http` dependency upgrade from `v0.25` to `v1.1.1`. The upgrade removed the transitive `cactoos` dependency that provided `BytesOf` and `HexOf` classes.

   - Removed imports: `org.cactoos.io.BytesOf`, `org.cactoos.text.HexOf`
   - Added a static helper method `bytesToHex(byte[] bytes)` to convert byte arrays to hex strings
   - Updated the digest calculation to use the new helper method

3. **`src/main/java/com/artipie/docker/misc/DigestFromContent.java`**:
   - Removed imports: `org.cactoos.io.BytesOf`, `org.cactoos.text.HexOf`
   - Updated to call `DigestedFlowable.bytesToHex()` instead

4. **`src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/ManifestEntityHeadTest.java`**:
   - Replaced `org.cactoos.list.ListOf` with `java.util.Arrays.asList()`

5. **`src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/ManifestEntityGetTest.java`**:
   - Replaced `org.cactoos.list.ListOf` with `java.util.Arrays.asList()`
